Black Sleeveless Dress by the Lanterns

Bold, urban, candid
WORKING NOTES
- The red lanterns and brick walls set the location.
- Keep the stone steps in the background for depth.
Try this: Keep the stone steps in the background for depth.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair and blunt bangs reaches up to a red paper
lantern. She wears a fitted black sleeveless
mock-neck dress with sheer panels at the waist
and a silver bangle. Behind her, red lanterns hang
above old brick walls and stone steps. Her
expression is calm, looking back over her shoulder.
Warm, late-afternoon light. Palette of black, red,
and weathered brick. Bold and urban, in the style of
a travel street-style photo.
